title: liparis compressa
intro: Liparis compressa, commonly known as the flat green orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Liparis compressa include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
